branded.why: A one-off or short-lived product that left no mark on how people eat.

about.text: A factory cheese first made by Frico and later by Friesland Foods, made from raw cow's milk at the Bergumerdam dairy in Bergum. It is named after Kollum, though it was not made there, and production ended in 2007 when the market shrank and hygiene rules for raw-milk processing tightened.

sources.text: Its makers, raw milk and history, from this page.
